# Dorothy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P6](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dorothy possesses roguish hazel eyes. Her appearance closely resembles [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), with the primary distinction being her eye color rather than dreamy dark eyes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Dorothy Gardner is characterized by her slim build and a jolly, rather tomboyish personality.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Traits

- jolly  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>
- tomboyish  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)</sub>

## Abilities

_Not yet known._

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Dorothy is the sister of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) and the sole member of her family in whom he confides. She traveled with her mother and sister to visit [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), arriving a day earlier than expected. Upon her arrival, she connected warmly and established a friendly bond with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P0](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0000), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P2](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0002), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P4](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0004), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P6](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0006), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), +81 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dorothy.md)

Dorothy first meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she and her family arrive a day earlier than expected for a visit, leading to a flustered yet humorous initial encounter. Despite the surprise, the friendly Dorothy quickly establishes a warm connection with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two go on to become intimate college friends during their time together.

- Friend of — intimate college friends  <sub>[v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

Dorothy is Roy's sister. She travels with her family to visit him while he is courting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), arriving a day ahead of schedule. While her brother pursues his romance with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Dorothy engages warmly with his social circle.

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>
